goal.objective:
Gather: make the complete event-planning job work for volunteer coordinators and helpers (no knowledge of our history). Source: objective.md.

Outcome: coordinator enters date, needs, commitments; gets useful proposed tasks; edits them naturally; sees consequences; assigns work (private test env); returns later to correct current state. Helpers find their work and report changes without learning our planning model. Exercise create, revise, assign, return, recover as one connected job in a private preview with real persisted state; a static demo or one happy path is not the outcome.

Quality: appealing, coherent, easy on phone and desktop; work and next action prominent. Explanations/history available, not dominant. Never drop qualifications or negatives when shortening text. Test rendered UI with full event, long explanations, many assignments, and sparse event; include empty, waiting, error, retry, undo, return states. Fix visual/comprehension flaws; if local repairs fail, rethink shared interaction.

Review: fresh independent reviewer on the rendered complete journey with realistic content, against objective.md. Repair material findings, re-exercise. Keep evidence gaps visible.

Authority: reversible changes, local tests, isolated data, private preview. No new integrations, publishing, real volunteer contact, invitations, live-event changes, purchases, irreversible actions without approval. Isolated test accounts, read back writes, keep restore path. Protect private data, access, money.

Budget: 750 NOK new model/API spend total, incl. delegates/retries; reserve for verification; unknown cost not free. At cap stop paid work, report remainder.

Real value needs coordinators over several events: prepare evaluation; never fabricate participation. If only external dependency blocks, name it and stop. Keep handoff: goal, progress, failures, budget, next action.
